Market today: The chip sector is reeling from Intel's massive 21% plunge, driven by a PC slowdown. This is the main driver for your tech-heavy book, amplified by broader crypto market jitters.

Your holdings: SOXL (-54.44%), MUU (-27.45%), SMCI (-21.54%), and SPAL (-40.52%) are all in deep drawdown with their stops significantly breached. These leveraged positions on margin are particularly vulnerable.

Watch: Keep a close eye on how the Intel news impacts other chip names and the broader tech sector. Geopolitical tensions in the Middle East also bear watching for overall market sentiment.

Bottom line: Prioritize risk management and re-evaluate positions with blown stops, especially your leveraged chip exposure.
plays: Re-evaluate SOXL, MUU, SMCI, and SPAL immediately. Their stops are clearly breached, and holding leveraged positions below their stops on margin is high risk.
Consider trimming SMH (-11.74%) to reduce chip sector exposure, given the Intel news and its current "TRIM" status.
No new buys today - hold and watch. The market mood for tech/chips is too uncertain for new long positions.
